newsitem.title: USA: Zing board approves Tactech unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Zing board approves Tactech unit spinoff.

text.p: Zing Technologies Inc said on Thursday it board of directors approved in principle the spinoff of all the common stock of its 90-percent owned subsidiary, Transitional Analysis Component Technology Inc to Zing shareholders.
The stock would be spun off to Zing shareholders as a dividend, subject to certain conditions including U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approval, Zing said.
Zing makes multi-chip power hybrid semiconductors and integrated power modules, and provides information services licensing proprietary software data bases.
The company reserved the right to cancel the spinoff if necessary. It said it expected filing a registration statement early in 1997.
